defects: The jaw line is hard and angular in three-quarter view.
Garment details are paint, not form: lapels, seams, stitching, buttons, studs, laces and the lames of the armour are drawn by the texture bake on smooth shapes.
The spacesuit has no helmet. The plates of the plate armour are rounded and thick.
Each outfit has its own colours only while the clothing colour is left at "Engine default"; a chosen colour replaces the main cloth colour and keeps the shirt, tie, buttons and stitching.
In heels the ankle is raised and the leg shortened by the same 2.7 % of stature, instead of the whole body standing taller.
No clip has been played or looked at on any of the reworked garments; how a long skirt or coat follows the legs is unknown.
Behind the knees the athletic outfit shows uneven shading.

entries.what: A complete AvatarForge avatar written by engine 0.9.0: 271,155 vertices, 369,108 triangles, 10 primitives, 13 materials, 5 PNG maps, 1 skin with 71 joints, 52 morph targets, 15 animations (idle 4.0 s … turn_360 2.0 s).
entries.licence: The owner's own engine output. The AvatarForge repository has no LICENSE file.
entries.use: Imported through the current engine on the host: skeleton adopted, 71 joints, 15 animations, every vertex weighted. A ready-made rigged and animated AvatarForge file for testing import and, once connected, native clip playback. Older generator: it shows the earlier face and garments.

entries.head: fd638fde15ab8dae51bfeec8da320590128d1e49
entries.what: The Khronos sample "CesiumMan": 3,273 vertices, 4,672 triangles, 1 JPEG texture, 1 skin with 19 joints, 1 animation of 2.0 s (57 channels: a walk cycle). No morph targets.
entries.licence: Byte-identical to KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets Models/CesiumMan/glTF-Binary/CesiumMan.glb (same Git blob 8586c4e6). That repository states: © 2017 Cesium, CC BY 4.0; the Cesium logo in the texture is a trademark.
entries.use: The best candidate for the first visible playback of an imported GLB: small, skinned, with a real clip. In the app it has clips and is not an AvatarForge file, so it opens in the Filament preview, where the animation controls appear. Through the native importer it is a static model; on the host its JPEG texture is not decoded, because the importer leaves JPEG to Android's image decoder (not checked on Android).
